# Calendar

Allow to visualise agendas and select dates.
See [Date & Time picker guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/date-time-picker/design/)

It is used by the <LinkTo kind="Components/DatePicker" story="docs">Date Picker</LinkTo> component.

### Year Range

Using `yearRange` prop will define a range of years around current date.

<Canvas of={CalendarStories.YearRange} />

You can also use `minYear`, `maxYear` or both to set a custom year range.
